name: Lumen Hotel & The Lisbon Light Show
description:
On a side street, this stylish hotel is a 2-minute walk from a metro station, and 4 km from both Castelo de S. Jorge and Praça do Comércio, a waterside plaza.
Modern rooms, some with colorful decor, feature floor-to-ceiling windows, flat-screen TVs and Wi-Fi, plus minibars and coffeemakers. Suites add living rooms; upgraded suites offer balconies.
A chic restaurant has a patio that features evening light shows projected onto the walls. Other amenities include a rooftop pool, a gym and co-working space. Breakfast and parking are available.

nearby_places.name: Castelo de São Jorge
nearby_places.description: 11th-century, hilltop Moorish castle & royal residence with palace ruins & archaeological museum.

nearby_places.name: Praça do Comércio
nearby_places.description: Waterside public plaza with a notable arch & statue, lined with outdoor cafes & shopping venues.

nearby_places.name: Santa Justa Lift
nearby_places.description: Cast-iron elevator with filigree details, built in 1902 to connect lower streets with Carmo Square.

nearby_places.name: Jerónimos Monastery
nearby_places.description: Late Gothic Manueline-style monastery housing archaeology & maritime museums in its wings.

nearby_places.name: Belém Tower
nearby_places.description: Landmark medieval fortified tower on tiny river island with rooftop terrace offering estuary views.

nearby_places.name: Lisbon Cathedral
nearby_places.description: Earthquakes have led to this cathedral being rebuilt many times in different architectural styles.

nearby_places.name: Calouste Gulbenkian Museum
nearby_places.description: Displays of art from Greek to Roman & Asian to European, plus gardens, shop & restaurant.

nearby_places.name: Carmo Archaeological Museum
nearby_places.description: Ruined Gothic church destroyed by an earthquake in 1755, with an evocative roofless nave & museum.

nearby_places.name: Tram 28
nearby_places.description: Classic yellow trams retaining original 1930s features like brass dials & polished wood interiors.

nearby_places.name: Museu Nacional do Azulejo
nearby_places.description: Museum of decorative azulejo tiles housed in a 16th-century monastery with a spectacular chapel.

nearby_places.name: LX Factory
nearby_places.description: This historical industrial complex houses an array of arty retailers & unique restaurants.

nearby_places.name: Monument to the Discoveries
nearby_places.description: Statue built in 1940 and made permanent in 1960 to mark 500 years since Henry the Navigator's death.

nearby_places.name: Miradouro de Santa Luzia
nearby_places.description: This popular observation deck with a pergola offers dramatic views of Lisbon & the Tagus River.

nearby_places.name: Rua Augusta Arch
nearby_places.description: Ornate 18th-century triumphal arch with sculpted figures & views over the city center.

user_review.comment: We stayed a week at Lumen Hotel.  The staff at the hotel are friendly, helpful, and extremely accommodating.  We were treated like family!  Felipe and Sergio were fabulous.  They went of their way to help us.   A breakfast buffet is served in the morning which is helpful prior to exploring the city and visiting attractions.  The hotel is located less than 2 blocks from the metro station (yellow line).  I highly recommend taking an Uber, especially if someone in your party has mobility issues.  I believe the staff at Lumen Hotel is the best I have ever experienced!
The room was clean and large.  Comfortable lobby, great breakfast, and kind, helpful employees throughout.
Love my stay here..service super awesome. Breakfast was great in the mornings. Location is alright not too close to city centre.
